tagline: A warm, faith-based place where little learners can play, grow, and feel known every day.

announcement.text: Now accepting enrollment packets — toddler and Pre-K openings are currently available.

announcements.title: Toddler and Pre-K enrollment is open
announcements.text: Little Cove is currently accepting enrollment packets for the toddler classroom and Pre-K for ages 3–5. Spots are limited and are reserved in the order completed enrollment steps are received.

announcements.title: Meet Kaitlyn, our Lead Teacher
announcements.text: Kaitlyn brings classroom experience, a heart for young learners, and a warm, encouraging approach to Little Cove. She is especially excited to help create a safe, fun, and loving classroom where every child can learn and grow.

announcements.title: Enrollment packets and next steps
announcements.text: Families can message Little Cove for an enrollment packet or schedule a tour. After a packet is submitted and availability is confirmed, the $35 enrollment fee is the final step to reserve a child’s spot.

features: A warm, nurturing environment where children can feel comfortable and known
Hands-on learning through play, books, art, music, and daily routines
Faith-based values woven into a welcoming, age-appropriate setting
Small class sizes and personal attention for each little learner

reviews.name: Community note
reviews.text: Our community needs a place like this and I know it’s going to thrive!

reviews.name: Little Cove family
reviews.text: The support, encouragement, and excitement around Little Cove has meant everything. We are getting so close.
